research_findings: Analyzed application state and recent modifications.
Identified React 19 anti-patterns regarding useRef during render inside AdaptiveCoachDemo, causing the app build/lint process to fail.
Identified asynchronous vitest timing issues causing missing act(...) wrappers inside DiagramCanvas testing, which violates React's test principles.
Identified missing DialogDescription leading to Radix UI accessibility warnings in FeedbackModal.
Identified database connectivity requirement for Next.js build due to blog posts prerendering inside sitemap.ts.
features_improved: DiagramCanvas tests are now correctly wrapped in act(...) to handle asynchronous state updates according to React 18+ guidelines.
AdaptiveCoachDemo no longer mutates and accesses refs during the render cycle, utilizing standard state and avoiding hydration mismatches or linter failures.
FeedbackModal UI satisfies Radix UI Dialog accessibility rules with screen-reader descriptions.
Sitemap generation handles offline databases during the build phase to avoid ECONNREFUSED pipeline crashes.
new_features_added: Added protective try-catch boundary around Prisma database fetches in blog-posts.ts to ensure robust Next.js pre-rendering.
next_steps_for_next_run: Upgrade the test suite to resolve missing JSDOM mocks for media device components (e.g. Voice features).
Investigate replacing NextAuth Next.js edge-runtime conflicts for full static site generation support.
Refactor remaining components containing `useRef` rendering access to completely conform with React Strict Mode.
